uncharged_runtime_import_only.role: Required imports of the charged executable; not independent mathematical evidence.

custody.verification_method: receipt pairs extracted mechanically with awk; sha256sum -c

controls: Moh bottom counts, actual orbit sizes, and relative stabilizer increments are separately named.
Prime marks denote generations; derivatives are written explicitly in the report.
The SD argument checks delta_child_top=-1, simple multiplicity, and minor threshold before using the ODE.
No necessary row is treated as a polynomial witness and no attainment is claimed.

mandatory_fixes: Reserve N for actual centre-orbit size; rename Moh bottom quantities B_n=(n/d2)V2 and B_m=(m/d2)V2.
Type A1_actual=den(L_actual*delta1) as a relative denominator increment, not a total orbit size.
Limit the corollary to arithmetic expressions literally transported by I1-I6; child-only integrality and Galois residues remain independent tests.
Read copied-range degree equality as a guaranteed scope, not an iff outside that range.

covered: Raw copied characteristic lattice under the Prop 6.3 scalar.
Transported radii for a fixed licensed first-support route.
Moh bottom root-count quantities B_n and B_m.
Actual relative bottom denominator increment A1.
ODE degree ratios at all matched levels and degree pairs on the copied range.
Contradiction of the typed simple-minor second-descent kill cell.
not_covered: Existence of a child route when descend_own returns an empty route set.
A total map or bijection between parent and child necessary configurations.
The child's own Galois residue laws at newly created or uncopied levels.
A parent counterpart for every child-side necessary condition.
Realizability or attainment by a polynomial pair.
Heavy second descent or u_s>1 terminal identification.
